column2:
The valuation model considers the fair value
of the un-harvested green leaf as at 30
September 2019. Green leaf volumes were
determined by assuming a 7 - day plucking
cycle for harvested leaf using October 2019
data. This was then valued using the 2019
similar competitors’ out-grower average
price.
